messages:
ida: ACME POC kickoff — need to lock prompt inventory + baseline evals, timeline (2 weeks), pricing ask from procurement, and security questionnaire handoff. Who can own what?

alex_w: I can take prompts + baseline evals. Need a sample of 5 canonical prompts and expected outputs. Also confirm model variant (redwood-45b-quant).

samir_k: I'll do infra/ops: capacity for 50 rps peak, can we start on a Dedicated trial? Any reqs for VPC or egress rules?

maya_g: I'll own pricing and contract Qs. Procurement asked for a per-1M token estimate and overage policy. Need expected usage profile to give numbers.

jordan_h: Security wants the questionnaire. @security_bot can you attach the last enterprise SQ + SSO/KMS answers?

security_bot: Attached the template: https://redwood.internal/sq/acme-2026-v1 (includes SSO, KMS, data retention answers). Note: customer requires SOC2 + isolated logs — Private deployment recommended for minimal friction.

ida: Great. Alex, can you post the prompt list & seed evals by EOD? Sam, open Dedicated trial request with infra team. Maya, share preliminary cost calc (reserving vs hosted). Jordan, coordinate security review with customer.

alex_w: Posting prompt baseline now:
```
1) Summarize customer support ticket in 2 bullets.
2) Generate product feature comparison given a short spec.
3) Extract entities: org_name, tax_id, region, contact_email.
4) Re-rank search results using query + context.
5) Compose polite onboarding email from template with variables.
```
Expectations: p50 latency <200ms on 512-token workloads, correctness target >90% on task-specific evals.

samir_k: Also will need an eval harness + seed dataset. Alex: can you flag ~20 examples per prompt (happy path + edge cases)?

alex_w: Yep — dropping CSV with 20 examples each in the shared folder: https://redwood.internal/poc/acme/prompts.csv. Will annotate expected outputs.

maya_g: Pricing calc (ballpark): hosted ~ $1.2k/mo for projected trial tokens. Dedicated trial quote pending (depends on reserved hours). Will send a short spreadsheet.

jordan_h: Customer flagged encryption at rest with their KMS — legal needs a key ownership clause. Adding to the SQ and notifying legal.

ida: OK action items recap: Alex = prompts + examples + eval set, Sam = Dedicated trial + infra reqs, Maya = pricing sketch + spreadsheet, Jordan = SQ updates + legal clause. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT for handoff to POC engineer. :thumbsup:

alex_w: +1. Will prep eval run scripts and include sample outputs.

samir_k: I'll ping infra once the trial request is in. If Private is required, schedule may slip by ~3 business days.

maya_g: Sending initial cost sheet in 30m.

jordan_h: Added the KMS clause to the SQ doc and tagged legal.

ida: Thanks everyone — moving to calendar invite now.
